rules.build: # psl-make-dafsa is a script that comes with libpsl. The package of libpsl # is built after this one and needs the list, so the script is taken from # its sources. Debian has it in a package of its own, which is built # without the rest of libpsl. cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" python3 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/libpsl/src/psl-make-dafsa" \ --input-format=psl \ --output-format=binary \ public_suffix_list.dat public_suffix_list.dafsa
rules.install:
DATA_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/publicsuffix"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" install -d -m 0755 "$DATA_DIR" install -m 644 public_suffix_list.dafsa public_suffix_list.dat "$DATA_DIR/" ln -s public_suffix_list.dat "$DATA_DIR/effective_tld_names.dat"
